id.description: Context whose DID is being set.

did.description: The DID this context acts as from now on, or `null` to leave the context with no DID of its own. A string MUST be a DID per DID Core §3.1 (`did:` method-name `:` method-specific-id); `pattern` applies to strings only, so `null` is not constrained by it. Anything that authenticated or signed as the previous DID keeps referring to it; this task does not migrate those references, and a consumer MUST NOT imply that it does.
